Folks,

I looked at raw signup headers for the batch (attached signup-headers.log). Technical summary:
- Many signups share the same browser UA fingerprint and identical Accept-Language headers — suggests scripted signups.
- Several accounts were created within seconds of each other with sequential email local-parts that only differ by a numeric suffix.
- I ran the email hashes against our previous abuse list; ~18 matches.

For next steps I suggest:
1) Temporary revoke of already-issued promo credits for the accounts that match the >80% abuse signature (we can tag and revoke in bulk).
2) Add edgehub.ai subdomain to a short-term throttle list for self-serve grants while we complete the audit.
3) Keep 2–3 obvious enterprise accounts on a manual-approve list if Marissa confirms them.

I'll start the revoke draft once we decide.

—Aditya
